Yes. Since your booking system is already in place, I’d look for a Toronto agency that specializes in content + paid acquisition, rather than someone trying to replace your booking software.

A few worth shortlisting:

The Influence Agency — Toronto full-service agency covering social content, influencer marketing, paid media, SEO and email. Good if you want a broader growth partner.

ORCAFY Marketing Agency — Etobicoke-based, with paid social plus content planning/creation. Their positioning is particularly relevant if you need better creative as well as ads.

Social Influenc. Agency — Especially interesting for a salon: its Toronto offering includes social marketing and an appointment-focused program, and its business profile includes salon-related experience.

Analytics & Beyond — Their salon-specific offering covers Instagram/TikTok content, Meta ads, Google/Maps visibility and retention, and they explicitly say they integrate with existing booking systems. 
Analytics & Beyond Marketing Inc.

The Salon Marketing Company — A more niche option: salon-specific Meta advertising and short-form video/Reels/TikTok production. Their listed Meta service starts at $129/month, with ad spend separate. 
Salon Marketing Co.
+1

BBMedia — Beauty/salon-focused, with visual content, influencer/KOL campaigns and booking-driven advertising; they cite Toronto-area salon clients. 
BrandBoosty
+1

My first three calls would be Analytics & Beyond, The Salon Marketing Company, and Social Influenc. They're closer to the specific problem—make the existing booking funnel perform better—rather than simply doing generic social media.

When you talk to them, ask for:

3–5 actual hair-salon case studies

Examples of Reels/ads they produced

Expected cost per booked appointment, not just clicks or leads

Whether they can use your existing booking link/system

Who owns the Meta/Google ad accounts and creative

A clear monthly content + ad-spend + management-fee breakdown

If you tell me your salon type, approximate monthly ad budget, and Toronto neighbourhood, I can narrow this to the best 3 agencies and compare them side-by-side.
